services.name: Captained Charter
services.desc: Have A Boat Day ⚓️ The charter vessel, Lorelei, is a beautiful Sabre 36 Express or Mainship Pilot 30 with classic lines of a downeast yacht that will turn heads in every harbor. They will be run by our Captains and crew members, so all you need to do is relax. Both boats have a large cockpit for entertaining, a shaded bridge deck area with an L-shaped settee, and a large cabin below with a dining area, full head with a shower, and a forward stateroom for one of those restful afternoon naps. Her wide swim platform makes it easy to board and disembark, and the swim ladder lets the swimmers come out of the water and rinse off with the hand-held shower. Additional Details Fuel Is Not Included

quotes.author: Carolyn S.
quotes.text: Amazing experience with Wickford Boat Rentals, Captain Dave and team. Dave knows the area so well, he can tell you anything you need to know in order to navigate successfully. The boats are as clean and well-maintained as what you would find on a showroom floor. It’s clear that service is a number one priority for their customers from the time you make a reservation until you leave the dock. This company serves as a model for how others should operate. I would highly recommend them.

quotes.author: Kathleen N.
quotes.text: Great experience with Dave and staff. From start to finish we had a wonderful experience with them. Dave was so friendly and helpful regarding our trip planning and his young staff were super nice. The boat was beautiful and handled some rough water without a problem. We took a day trip with a group of friends out to Rose Island and up to Tiverton for lunch. The day couldn’t have been better. Highly recommend Wickford Boat Rentals. See you next year!

quotes.author: Celi P.
quotes.text: Best service! Owner is professional, friendly, and walks you through every step from what is available on the boat, to routes, to best practice and more. Boat was in excellent condition. Everything was prompt, from start to finish. Makes you want to return again and again. Would recommend to anyone without a doubt. First rental experience and this made me want to continue on the journey!

quotes.author: Robert M.
quotes.text: Great fleet, great boats, great staff. One of the only places you can rent boats like that in the area. We looked all around the area for similar rental places and this is the only place we found. The operator of the business is very nice and informative.
